modern: Revere what is best in the universe; and this is what makes use of all things and directs all things. And in the same way also revere what is best in yourself; and this is of the same kind as that. For in you too, what makes use of everything else is this, and your life is directed by this.
original: Reverence that which is best in the universe; and this is that which makes use of all things and directs all things. And in like manner also reverence that which is best in thyself; and this is of the same kind as that. For in thyself also, that which makes use of everything else is this, and thy life is directed by this.
